release.environment.help: An environment binds a local provider and site registered by an administrator. Saving configuration establishes configuration only; it does not establish connectivity or deployment verification.
release.environment.name: Environment name
release.environment.no_provider: No local release provider is registered
release.environment.no_provider_help: Ask an administrator to configure the provider and sites using the release integration guide. No demo options or arbitrary URLs are accepted here.

release.environment.conflict: The environment changed. The name and health-policy drafts are retained. Read the latest version, review it, then save.

release.prepare.select_environment: Select and read an actual release environment.
release.prepare.rollback_help: This prepares an independent rollback plan requiring a new review, approval and execution. It does not directly change the environment.
release.prepare.help: Read the server preview, save an immutable plan, then have an authorized person review it. Previewing does not deploy.
release.execution_lane.label: Deployment execution
release.execution_lane.shared_tasks: Ordinary tasks can continue to use the shared pool.
release.prepare.not_created: No deployment has been created and no environment generation has been reserved. Saving creates a fixed plan for review.
release.decision.title: Review this fixed plan
release.decision.label: Review decision
release.decision.revoke_help: Revocation prevents future authorization using this plan. It does not undo a content switch that already occurred or perform an automatic rollback.
release.decision.placeholder: Record the scope, file fingerprints, tests and acceptance evidence you checked, and the reason for this decision.
release.decision.execute_help: The server rechecks current permissions, candidate evidence, approval and the environment generation. Accepting an execution request does not establish a content switch or passing health checks.
release.decision.conflict: The plan state or evidence changed. Your draft is retained. You can copy the review reason before closing. Read the plan again, compare the changes and review it again; changing the version alone cannot authorize another execution.
release.intro.artifacts: Read only the bytes actually received and sealed from execution workers. File existence, build success and package-test success remain separate facts.
release.intro.candidates: Fix actual files, execution proofs and formal acceptance evidence into an immutable delivery.
release.intro.environments: Configuration declarations, highest reserved generation, actual active content and health observations are shown separately.
release.intro.plans: Review the exact candidate, target and evidence, then approve and execute that same immutable plan.
release.intro.deployments: Track actual external operations. Content switches, health observations, reconciliation and rollback remain separate facts.
release.recovery.title: A release request awaits confirmation
release.recovery.help: The original path, version, complete request and operation identifier are retained. Recovery reads current facts without generating a new deployment operation.

release.list.adjust: Adjust the name filter or load more records.

release.list.more_available: Current window; more records are available
release.list.complete: The server has returned the current scope
release.detail.stale: The last-read facts are retained below. The current connection is unconfirmed; write actions are temporarily unavailable.
release.detail.absent: The exact object has not been read
release.detail.retry: Read the object within the current project again.
release.dialog.help: Submit only actual objects and exact evidence in the current project. Keep the original operation for recovery if its result is unknown.
release.list.unread_title: List has not been read yet
release.list.unread_help: There is no confirmed record scope. Read again using the error notice above.
release.empty.artifacts: No actual build artifacts received yet
release.empty.artifacts_help: Run an administrator-configured trusted build and have the execution worker upload the actual bytes. A registered address cannot replace the files.
release.empty.candidates_help: Receive the artifact, derive actual build and package-test proofs and formally accept the tasks before fixing the delivery scope.
release.empty.environments_help: Create an environment after an administrator registers a local provider and site. Configuration declarations do not establish deployment verification.
release.empty.plans_help: Choose an environment for an immutable candidate, read the actual preview and save it for review.
release.empty.deployments_help: A durable deployment operation appears only after an approved fixed plan is executed.
release.artifact.title: Actual artifact files
release.artifact.help: Sealing means the server has received and verified the actual bytes. Build and package-test proofs are shown separately; a formal candidate cannot be fixed without them.
release.artifact.no_build: No actual successful build proof yet.
release.artifact.no_test: No successful package-test proof for these artifact bytes yet.
release.candidate.prepare: Prepare deployment plan from this candidate
release.candidate.acceptance_help: The task versions, runs and review evidence below were fixed at creation. The server checks current eligibility separately.
release.environment.capability: The provider is registered. Connectivity and complete release and rollback verification still require their own actual evidence.
release.environment.barrier_help: The original operation holds the environment barrier. Reconcile its unknown result before deploying past it or changing the policy.
release.environment.edit: Edit name, policy and archive state
release.plan.rollback_source: View actual historical rollback source operation
release.plan.required_health: Actual content that must be observed after deployment
release.plan.no_review: No deployment review decision yet. Ordinary workflow approval cannot replace this exact approval.
release.plan.gate_help: Actions follow the server's current eligibility and allowed actions. Submission rechecks permissions, evidence and environment. Approval does not establish deployment success.
release.deployment.title: Actual deployment operation
release.deployment.help: Reconciliation reads actual observations from the authenticated provider without redeploying or accepting a manually declared success. Rollback requires a new plan and approval; a current failure is not automatically shown as rolled back.
release.deployment.no_observation: No authenticated provider observation yet. Queueing and control-plane request acceptance do not establish a content switch or passing health checks.
release.deployment.no_history: No historical observations to list yet.

release.validation.proofs: Build and package-test proofs must bind the same artifact fingerprint and source commit.
release.validation.tasks: Enter a candidate name and select actual formally accepted tasks.
release.validation.plan: Read the candidate and environment in the current project before preparing a plan.
release.validation.preview_stale: The prepared content or environment changed. Preview the plan again.
release.validation.blocked: Deployment conditions are not met. Review the blockers first.
release.validation.create: The current preview does not grant permission to create a plan. Refresh permissions and the preview.
